purpose: Independent exact-byte rereview of the RT17 successor against the three RT16 blocking findings, the retained RT15 semantic/fixture/lease boundary, the 51-input authenticated snapshot, and active return-graph falsifiers. This review does not apply, seal, freeze, integrate, demonstrate, qualify or release the candidate.

scope.decisionRule: PASS requires stable exact subject bytes, every retained predecessor gate, independent closure of all three RT16 findings, a complete fail-closed returned-object identity graph traversal, and zero new blocker. A clean concrete return graph is necessary but does not substitute for the declared active edge falsifiers.
scope.authoredCheckerRole: Supplemental checker-scope evidence only; its status, fixtures, golden commitments and green selftest are not this review's oracle.

reviewerIndependenceAndLineage.predecessorReviewLineageDisclosure: This reviewer authored the exact RT16 independent rejection that RT17 answers. The reviewer therefore has finding-lineage involvement, but authored none of the RT17 successor bytes. No RT16 conclusion was reused as proof; every retained gate and each repair was rerun against RT17.

candidateBlindPreparation.statement: The RT17 repair harness and checklist were completed before any RT17 path was listed, read, statted, hashed, parsed, imported or executed.

exactByteReviewBasis.strictJson: PASS for both JSON subjects with duplicate-key, float, NaN and Infinity refusal

verdict.effect: RT17 must remain CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED and must not supersede RT16/RT15, enter Evidence or OP6 bindings, or be used as architecture-freeze authority.
verdict.statement: The EP8 API/receipt repair and the real D9 v1.10 dataclass repair pass independently, and the exact current returned snapshot has no forbidden identity hit. The candidate is nevertheless rejected because its graph-quarantine algorithm is not the exhaustive fail-closed traversal the contract claims: class dictionaries, name-mangled slots and memoryview backing buffers are invisible, and a hostile mapping traversal escapes as an uncontrolled exception.

blockingFindings.finding: The returned-object quarantine says attributes, every slot, mappings and executable/runtime edges are traversed before return. The implementation explicitly makes every class object a leaf, reads private __slots__ without Python name mangling, treats memoryview as atomic instead of following its backing object, and does not convert a raising custom mapping traversal into a controlled finding. A forbidden identity can therefore be reachable while the quarantine reports zero hits.

independentFalsifiers.root: a reachable class whose class dictionary contains the forbidden sentinel
an object with __slots__=('__hidden',) containing the forbidden sentinel
a memoryview whose obj is the forbidden exact bytes object

blockingFindings.authoredCheckerEscape: The authored edge selftest passes 16/16 because it includes only a simple public slot and omits class dictionaries, name-mangled/inherited slots, memoryview backing objects and hostile mapping access. The candidate mutation named graph edge omission only removes a declaration string from JSON; exact-candidate equality rejects that textual change without testing the traversal algorithm.
blockingFindings.whyConcreteGraphCleanIsInsufficient: The exact current snapshot was clean under both algorithms, but the contract makes the quarantine algorithm the guard against a returned runtime edge. A walker that cannot observe required edge classes cannot establish that invariant for its own admitted return type or for a checker/runtime successor using the same binding.
requiredRepair: Traverse class dictionaries and the class edge of non-builtin returned objects; do not make type objects unconditional leaves.
Resolve inherited and double-underscore slots to their actual mangled storage names and test both direct and inherited private slots.
Traverse memoryview.obj and any other admitted buffer wrapper to the backing object before treating the view as atomic.
Convert custom mapping/attribute access failures and depth/node exhaustion into explicit controlled quarantine findings.
Embed all four falsifiers beneath a complete returned-snapshot root, require the authored and independent walkers to detect the same forbidden identity, and retain cycle/budget controls.
Publish a successor and obtain a different-author exact-byte review; do not patch or apply RT17 in place.

rt16FindingRereview.evidence: The exact current VerifiedSemanticRTSnapshotV2 is data-only with respect to EP8 receipt/fixtures and is clean against the complete exact forbidden identity set. Authored traversal visited 21,712 nodes with zero hits; the independent traversal visited 7,920 nodes with zero hits and zero traversal errors. RT17-PF-01 shows the enforcement algorithm is incomplete, so the return-surface repair cannot be accepted as a closed invariant.

The exact ordered nine-name API was derived from frozen RT13, every actual authenticated export was wrapped and called under poisoned ambient module/cwd conditions, call counts and typed results were independently reconstructed, and the returned receipt contains no callable/module/loader/authority edge.

Exact check-d9-v1.10.py bytes execute without decorator/source transformation under a collision-refusing digest-derived temporary module registration. The real seven-field frozen dataclass has generated equality/repr and rejects both setattr and delattr; the registry and trace state are restored.

normal.summary: 51 frozen inputs read once; byte-bearing fixtures 7/2 and 5/3; exact RT13 basis; authored graph-clean return; real v1.10 dataclass; candidate not applied

selftest.checkerScopeGap: No class-dictionary, private-slot, memoryview-backing or raising-custom-mapping traversal falsifier is present.

residuals.statement: Even after a graph repair, all retention acceptance, application, cross-surface Evidence binding and architecture freeze actions remain separate owning-lane decisions.
The Python verifier is architecture-test machinery and does not demonstrate Rust capability privacy, storage behavior, crash durability, performance, product qualification or release readiness.

nonClaims: The green authored checker does not override this independent blocking falsifier.
A zero-hit scan of the current exact return graph does not prove an algorithm that omits required edge classes.
This review does not reopen the independently passing EP8 or D9 v1.10 repair results except through a future successor delta.
This review does not promote RT15, RT16, RT17, D9, Evidence, OPERABILITY or OP6.
